paragraphs: R' Nicha bar Sava — Yevamot, beginning of chapter 9, and Kilayim, beginning of chapter 9.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The index heading records the alternatives סבה and סבא; the body writes סבא. Both citations point to the beginning of chapter 9.

Heading alternatives סבה and סבא remain; the body uses סבא. Nicha’s title is abbreviated and retained as R'. Both רפ״ט locators are conventionally beginning of chapter9, superseding older end and rafat89 guesses. No modern daf, exact edition mapping or identity has been verified. Earlier printed wording refers only to the supplied digital label; no printed page was inspected.
